The '''2027 Pretoria Capitals season''' is the fifth season of the franchise in the [[SA20]].<ref>{{cite web |title=BETWAY SA20 SEASON 5 FIXTURES ANNOUNCED |url=https://www.sa20.co.za/news/betway-sa20-season-5-fixtures-announced |date=23 July 2026 |access-date=24 July 2026 |website=SA20.co.za |language=en}}</ref> The team is captained by [[Keshav Maharaj]] and coached by [[Sourav Ganguly]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Pretoria Capitals name Ganguly head coach, Pollock assistant coach in SA20 |url=https://www.cricinfo.com/story/sa20-2025-26-sourav-ganguly-appointed-pretoria-capitals-head-coach-1500271 |access-date=3 August 2026 |website=Cricinfo}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Keshav Maharaj to lead Pretoria Capitals at SA20 |url=https://www.cricinfo.com/story/keshav-maharaj-to-lead-pretoria-capitals-at-sa20-1515428 |access-date=3 August 2026 |website=SA20}}</ref>
